notes: No Contradicted claim falls in the six verdict areas. Every triage test that asserts an action, reason or threshold matches doc 10 values, and the synthetic config matches doc 10 Section 0. The three Contradicted claims are all area other: (1) the performance tool simulates timings with random numbers, and the v0.1/v1.0 test reports present those numbers as device measurements (D4 warp p50=p95=680.0 equals the simulator clamp); (2) EstimationGoldenVectorsTest rewrites the golden vectors and their manifest on every run; (3) the defect log is empty while the v1.0 report lists 53 closed defects, including 12 S1. Because of (1) and (3), the committed test reports cannot count as evidence for physical exit criteria, so those are Unknown. Other gaps: bench tests for TC-CAP-03/04/08/09 and TC-CARD-07 return early and pass with no assertion; no nightly workflow; no Schemathesis or MobSF anywhere in the repository; Python parity tests are not in CI. Tests were not executed (Bash limited to git, drift_inventory and trace).
